The mixed (n-1,n-1) gradient pairing is positive by adding one rank-one cone factor, so ordinary Hermitian CS applies.

Global smooth approximation plus the checked local correction transfers quasicontinuity to canonical bounded admissible book potentials.

Rough coefficient domination passes through the already proved ORDERED limits by variation lower semicontinuity on opens, followed by outer capacity.
The countable weighted lemma uses compact K minus G for Dini and bounded Tietze extension against the whole measure; no closed-indicator weak limit is asserted.
Recursive simultaneous convergence multiplies only order-zero degree p-1 currents before applying ddc, including p=m.
Symmetry is deduced only after joint smooth convergence, avoiding an exchange of unproved iterated limits.
Fixed nonclosed omega powers preserve distributional limits, while positivity and local mass bounds justify the Q_p weak-current conclusion.
